CLOUDFLARED 2026.9.3 — EMBEDDED GO MODULE LICENSES AND NOTICES

We bundle the official 32-bit Windows cloudflared 2026.9.3 executable.
Binary SHA-256: 9B95DDC2EBA67B86ED3DC4CC2A15881960563031B52CE564376AF41FB91AD402
Official binary checksum: https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/tag/2026.9.3
Build commit: 96d39adbc812dc7363834bda908970c1a2560a72 (vcs.modified=true in the binary).
Go toolchain/runtime: go1.26.8 (windows/386).

This inventory comes from the Go build metadata embedded in that exact binary. It lists all 66 recorded Go modules, including the effective source of two replaced modules. License identifiers for 64 modules were checked against deps.dev at the recorded version. The two replacement forks were checked against their exact LICENSE files. We also retrieved all 66 exact-version module source archives from proxy.golang.org and included the 100 LICENSE, NOTICE, COPYING, and PATENTS files found in those archives below, including nested files.

The license identifiers in a row are detected licenses within that module archive. Multiple identifiers do not mean every file offers a choice among those licenses. Consult the included notice texts and upstream source for file-level conditions. Build metadata does not expose unrecorded code copied into cloudflared itself, and its vcs.modified=true flag means the public commit alone does not establish bit-for-bit source provenance for the executable.

Cloudflared's own Apache-2.0 text is in LICENSE beside this document. Cloudflare's service terms and privacy policy also govern its tunnel service; those are separate from the open-source licenses below.

## Permitted Use

- **Editorial and Press:** You may use the Brand Assets in blog posts, news articles, video reviews, and public presentations that discuss, review, or reference the quic-go project.

- **Reference:** You may use the Brand Assets to indicate your project's compatibility with or dependence on quic-go (e.g., "Powered by quic-go").

- **Modification:** Modify the Brand Assets in any way (including changing colors, aspect ratio, or obscuring the image). Resizing the image while maintaining the original aspect ratio is permitted.
